description: This PHP source file defines the class YamlFileLoader, which loads and parses YAML service definition files for Drupal, including handling caching, validation, and service configuration.

classes.name: YamlFileLoader
classes.description: A class responsible for loading, parsing, and caching YAML service definition files in Drupal, with support for validation, service configuration, and integration with Symfony's dependency injection components.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the loader with a container and sets up the file cache.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a YAML file, utilizing cache, and processes parameters and service definitions.

methods.name: parseDefinitions
methods.description: Parses the 'services' section of the YAML content and processes each service definition.

methods.name: parseDefaults
methods.description: Parses the '_defaults' section for default service configuration options.

methods.name: parseDefinition
methods.description: Parses an individual service definition, handling aliases, class, factory, tags, and other configurations.

methods.name: loadFile
methods.description: Loads and decodes a YAML file, with validation and error handling.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the decoded YAML content to ensure it has correct structure and keys.

methods.name: resolveServices
methods.description: Resolves service references, tagged values, and expressions within service definitions.
